definitions.full: H4014. Mibtsar II. מִבְצָר proper name, masculine Edomite chief Gen 36:42 = 1Chr 1:53 ; A ᵐ5 L Μαζαρ , A (in Chronicles) Μαβσαρ ; — on proper name, of a location Mabsar (Onom. 277, 63; 137, 11 ) compare Buhl Edom. 38 ).
